items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Slide or Val, I asked him. Slide.

ctx.x: He said, what kind of trombone did Frankie Dusen play? He was good, Frankie Dusen. But I didn't think he could read.
Slide or Val, I asked him. Slide.
He couldn't read, I don't know what I'm saying.
